labels.comments: Kirsten and Jeff were very accommodating and supportive. A lovely couple who really "get" the AirB&B experience. It's a great little pad and just minutes from central Toronto by 24/hr streetcar on Queen East. *Recommended*

labels.comments: Wies and Dorota were very accommodating and provided everything we'd ever need. The basement suite was just the right size for 3 people and it felt very homey. It has the quaint charm of a real Toronto home. The apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood that is accessible by the 504 streetcar and Dundas West subway station, and right smack in the middle of the busy and quieter areas in Toronto.
labels.note: hài lòng về chủ nhà, căn hộ ấm cúng, di chuyển thuận tiện

labels.comments: This place was perfect for our needs. The space is exactly as advertised and is plenty of space for 2 people. Lina and Paul were the kindest hosts and had some great recommendations. Their property is lovely and sits in a relaxing neighborhood. I loved the trail that leads down to the lake right near their house. It's a doable distance from the downtown area no matter if you've got a car or not. Plenty of public transportation nearby that is fairly easy to figure out, plus, if you need help Lina or Paul will be more than accommodating I'm sure. I would definitely re-book this place in the future! Thanks for helping to make a great trip!
labels.note: hài lòng về chủ nhà, di chuyển thuận tiện

labels.comments: Upon arriving into town, Sean kindly greeted me at the property to check me in. He was a super gentleman. I was shown the condo, how the building worked and was welcomed with open arms. The listing was super accurate, it was a great cozy spot right in the heart of downtown Toronto. The place was fully furnished with everything you could possibly need, all the way down to the utensils and kitchen seasonings. The view from the balcony is amazing, and you can see BMO Field where Toronto FC plays. There are so many things within walking distance, and the places that are a little further out aren't any longer than an Uber ride for a few minutes. You can't go wrong with this spot, and I literally have zero complaints. This will be my first choice when I come back to Toronto.
labels.note: hài lòng về chủ nhà, căn hộ đầy đủ trang thiết bị, di chuyển thuận tiện

labels.comments: The house is located in a quiet residential community but just a few minutes walk you will find all kinds of local foods/stores/etc. Sandy is an awesome host! Feel free to ask her about various places to visit and she will be more than happy to tell you all about them. Her companion Roxy is also a sweet dog, great with people! Overall very nice experience!
